title: slopvac v3 shared definitions
description: Shared $defs referenced by every v3 artifact schema. Shapes are frozen by slopvac-8l4.2.19; owners fill semantics. A PR editing a def links the owner bead.

Span.description: Half-open range [start, end) of byte offsets into the original file bytes, BOM included. The end is exclusive, start is at most end, and both offsets fall on code point boundaries and never between the CR and LF of one CRLF. Semantics owned by slopvac-8l4.2.11; see docs/contract/positions.md.

LineCol.description: One-based line and column. The column counts Unicode code points from the line start, after any BOM, and a tab counts as one. Output formats that need another unit convert from the span. Semantics owned by slopvac-8l4.2.11; see docs/contract/positions.md.

Edit.description: Replace the source bytes in span with text, written verbatim. A zero-width span inserts. Edits in one set use original offsets and must not overlap. Semantics owned by slopvac-8l4.2.11; see docs/contract/positions.md.

PackId.description: Pack identifier. Semantics owned by slopvac-8l4.2.3.

RuleId.description: Qualified rule identifier <pack>:<id>. Semantics owned by slopvac-8l4.2.3.

Severity.description: Finding severity. Excludes off: 2.x config accepts off to disable a rule, so off belongs to config (owned by slopvac-8l4.2.5), not to findings. Semantics owned by slopvac-8l4.2.3.

RuleProvenance.description: Where a rule came from. Semantics owned by slopvac-8l4.2.3.

ConfigSource.description: Config layer and location a setting came from. Layer order and file semantics are in docs/contract/config.md. Semantics owned by slopvac-8l4.2.5.

layer.description: Layer name, lowest priority first: core, style, genre, extends, project, override, front-matter, directive, cli. env marks the sticky environment switches.

file.description: Path relative to the project root, or pack:<id>/<path> for a pack file. Absent where no file holds the value: core, cli and env.

ContextTag.description: Text-context label such as prose or code. Semantics owned by slopvac-8l4.2.4.

SchemaVersion.description: Root artifact schema version. Semantics owned by slopvac-8l4.2.12.

ApiVersion.description: Plugin API version, separate from schema_version. Semantics owned by slopvac-8l4.2.12.
